movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Worry Seed
movelist.effect: You choose one of the target’s Abilities. Worry Seed changes that Ability to Insomnia for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Absorb
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Water Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Fire Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Fire Type Move, the coat is removed.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one Status Affliction. Leaf Guard’s Frequency is ignored if used during Sunny Weather.
